intent.raw: get the current state of implementation architecture and model, deriving it from spec, then use @projects/goldenquill/victor/ discovery pattern to explain for the team
intent.objective: Derive the current implementation architecture and data model of the goldenquill-promotion-governance feature strictly from its spec documents, then render a team-facing explanation using the victor discovery pattern (discovery + engineer/ontology/system views), source-backed and honest about unresolved gaps.
intent.operator_sentence: get the current state of implementation architecture and model, deriving it from spec, then use the victor discovery pattern to explain for the team

steps.name: Ingest and scope the promotion-governance spec corpus
stop_conditions: Stop if a referenced spec doc is missing or empty; report gap rather than infer.
Stop ingestion at the spec boundary; do not read implementation code or org data.

steps.name: Derive current implementation architecture and data model from spec
stop_conditions: Stop if architecture cannot be traced to a spec selector; mark as undefined, never invent.
Stop and flag where the spec defers a decision (TBD / fixture-only L0 boundary) instead of resolving it here.

steps.name: Distill the load-bearing implementation model to its smallest coherent unit
stop_conditions: Stop when the distilled model recomposes back to the full architecture handle without loss of a load-bearing boundary.

steps.name: Render team explanation in the victor discovery pattern (discovery + engineer/ontology/system views)
stop_conditions: Stop if any view restates a claim owned by another view; nothing-decided-twice discipline, cross-reference instead.
Stop if a view smooths over an open question (OQ-*/B-*); honest-gap discipline requires it be named.

steps.name: Validate every explanation claim traces to a spec selector (drift check)
stop_conditions: Block sharing if any load-bearing claim lacks a spec selector.
Flag if an explanation claim conflicts with the spec; route repair back to s4.

gates.condition: Derivation and rendering are read-only over spec; no spec doc, definition, glossary, sigil, or spell is mutated or promoted.
Every load-bearing architecture/model claim in the explanation cites a concrete spec selector.
Open questions, blockers, and fixture-only L0 boundaries are shown as honest gaps, not resolved or smoothed.
Team-facing explanation pack is reviewed by the operator before it is shared with the team.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Step s4 fans out into four independent authoring lanes (discovery + three views) that share one distilled model but own disjoint claims.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The victor pattern is explicitly multi-view with a nothing-decided-twice discipline; role-bound sibling authors keep each view's claim ownership clean and let the parent synthesize the cross-reference map.
context: Victor's four files each own distinct claims and cross-reference rather than restate.
Engineer/ontology/system views differ in altitude and would drift if written in one pass.
Open-question residue (OQ-*/B-*) must be preserved verbatim across views, not re-adjudicated per lane.

roles.purpose: Layperson orientation + the load-bearing learning-loop narrative + open business questions.
Decision inventory with verdicts and designed-vs-built status.
Node/edge types, schema contracts, and OQ residue.
Stakeholder altitude, shape, and given-vs-optimized framing.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Spawn 4 role-bound authoring subagents (discovery + engineer/ontology/system views) over the distilled impl model, joined by parent synthesis into one victor-pattern pack? Each returns its view draft + claim-to-selector evidence.

boundaries.contract: Spec is consumed read-only as source truth; the explanation pack is a downstream derivative and never edits or re-versions the spec.
Each authored claim returns with a concrete spec selector so the drift check can confirm or reject it.

authority.memory: none (no memory write in this route)

state_namespaces.write_policy: write generated victor-pattern pack only; never write back into spec

promotion_splits.target: Inventory / Ontology / glossary / sigil / spell knowledge
promotion_splits.rule: A team explanation derived from spec is not knowledge promotion; promoting any derived claim requires the owning capability's review, not this route.

promotion_guardrails: This dispatch validates and routes only; it does not execute the derivation or render the pack.
No spec, definition, glossary, sigil, or spell is promoted or mutated by this route.
The team explanation is a derivative artifact and carries no promotion authority over the model it explains.
